description: This Java source file defines an abstract class AbstractEvaluator that provides the core functionality for evaluating mathematical or logical expressions. It handles tokenization, operator precedence, brackets, functions, and constants, serving as a base class for creating concrete evaluators.

classes.name: AbstractEvaluator
classes.description: An abstract class providing a framework for evaluating expressions, supporting functions, constants, operators, brackets, and variables. It manages tokenization, evaluation order, and function/operator precedence, serving as a base class for specific evaluators.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: Evaluates a string expression, optionally with a given evaluation context, returning the result of type T.

methods.name: getOperators
methods.description: Returns a collection of all operators supported by this evaluator.

methods.name: getFunctions
methods.description: Returns a collection of all functions supported by this evaluator.

methods.name: getConstants
methods.description: Returns a collection of all constants supported by this evaluator.

methods.name: getPosftfixExpression
methods.description: Returns the postfix notation of the last evaluated expression as a string.
